_readme: THE MANIFEST. This file is the whole point of the rewrite: it binds each source screen
to a specific copy block from Design/StoreScreenshots/copy.json by NAME, never by index.
id      - output filename stem, also the human name of the scene
screen  - source screenshot base name under screenshots/<device>/<locale>/
theme   - 'light' | 'dark' | omitted (auth.png has no theme variant)
themeByLocale - per-locale theme override, for locales whose captures are one theme only
onlyLocales   - restrict a scene to the locales that actually have its source screen
copy    - a readable copy-block alias (see COPY_BLOCKS in the generator) or 'fallback:N'
why     - the justification that the caption is TRUE of this exact screen. If you cannot
write this line honestly, the pairing is wrong — drop the scene instead.
Order in the array = order in the store listing. Scenes follow the real user flow.
Copy block 'live' ('Your listing is live' / 'Status and link always at hand') is used by
exactly ONE scene: android-phone 'live', restricted to ua, the only locale with a capture
of a published listing. Every other locale's furthest captured state is the pre-publish
confirmation sheet, and captioning that as 'live' would be the exact screenshot/caption lie

iphone.why: The welcome screen's own subtitle is literally 'photo in -> listing out', which is verbatim the 'Photo in, listing out' sub. Sign-in and guest mode are both offered, so 'Sell faster with AI' reads as the promise, not a claim about state.

This IS the new-listing input screen: 'Nowe ogloszenie', 'Dodaj 1-8 zdjec', three real photo thumbnails, Aparat / Galeria buttons and the 'Generuj z AI' CTA. Pills 'Camera'/'Gallery' name buttons actually on screen.

The screen says 'we are analysing your photos and writing the perfect title, description and price' and lists exactly those steps. 'AI writes text while you wait' + 'Title, description and price' is a description of what is on screen, not a claim.
Same screen later: the checklist has flipped to green ticks on upload / analyse / title / description / price. 'AI helps with text, price and details' enumerates the visible ticked steps.

Shows the generated title and description in editable cards above the price, with the publish CTA still pending. 'Review everything before posting' / 'Edit text, price and details' is exactly the available action.

Bottom of the same screen: prefilled Details (condition, brand, size), Location, an 'everything is ready' banner and the single green 'Opublikuj na OLX' button. 'Publish in one tap' / 'A ready listing with zero extra work' is literally the state shown.

The confirmation sheet 'Ready to publish?' showing final title, OLX category path and price with 'Yes, publish' / 'Wait, I want to edit'. 'Final check before OLX' is precisely this sheet. Note it is still PRE-publish, so no 'live' wording.

ipad.why: Same welcome screen as on iPhone, landscape: 'photo in -> listing out' is on the screen itself, with OLX sign-in and guest mode both offered.

The one genuinely tablet-adaptive screen: persistent left navigation rail, three-across photo grid, side-by-side Aparat / Galeria. Pills 'Camera'/'Gallery' name visible buttons. Best proof this is a real iPad app, so it carries the tablet story.

The analysing screen states 'we are analysing your photos and writing the ideal title, description and price' above the five-step pipeline, so 'AI writes text while you wait' + 'Title, description and price' describes what is on screen. MUST be analysing_start, not analysing_progress: on iPad the progress capture raced the AI and grabbed the result screen instead in bg, pt and ro (byte-identical to result_top_dark in bg/pt). analysing_start_dark is a genuine analysing screen in every locale.

The payoff frame: 'Gotowe w 26 sekund', generated title and description in editable cards, price, publish CTA. 'Review everything before posting' / 'Edit text, price and details' is exactly the offered action. Dark chosen because the light variant clips the price glyph.
Bottom of the same screen with the prefilled Szczegoly attribute card and the publish CTA. Light chosen because the dark variant sits at a different scroll offset with no Szczegoly card at all.
The pre-publish confirmation sheet with final title, OLX category path and price. 'Final check before OLX' is literally this sheet. Still pre-publish, so no 'live' wording.

android-phone.why: Verified on the pl capture: 'Hej, witaj w SellSnap' with the subtitle 'Wrzuc zdjecie, dostan ogloszenie — AI robi reszte', which is verbatim the 'Photo in, listing out' sub. Both 'Kontynuuj z OLX' and guest mode are offered, so 'Sell faster with AI' reads as the promise, not a claim about state.

This IS the new-listing input screen: 'Nowe ogloszenie', 'Dodaj 1-8 zdjec. My zajmiemy sie reszta.', three real photo thumbnails, the '+ Dodaj' tile and the 'Generuj z AI' CTA. Pills 'Camera'/'Gallery' name the two ways to add the photos this screen is asking for.

'Przygotowujemy Twoje ogloszenie' / 'Analizujemy Twoje zdjecia i piszemy idealny tytul, opis i cene...' plus the live step list (Przesylanie zdjec done, Analizowanie zdjec in progress, Tworzenie tytulu, Pisanie opisu, Szacowanie ceny). 'AI writes text while you wait' + 'Title, description and price' is a readout of the screen. analysing_progress is deliberately NOT used: it races the AI and can capture the result screen instead, and ro/bg have no such capture at all.

The payoff frame: photo carousel, 'Gotowe w 21 sekund — przejrzyj przed publikacja.', then the generated Tytul and Opis in editable cards each with Kopiuj/AI affordances. 'Review everything before posting' / 'Edit text, price and details' is exactly what the screen invites — and the banner itself says review before publishing.

Bottom of the same screen: the OLX Kategoria path plus a Szczegoly card already filled in from the photos (Stan: Uzywane, Marka: New Balance, Rozmiar 40, Kolor Brazowy). 'Prepare listings with ready-made suggestions' is literally that card, and 'Less busywork, more sales' claims no state. NOT captioned 'Publish in one tap' like the iPhone set: these Android captures have no simulated location, so the CTA reads 'Publikuj - 1 do poprawki' (1 to fix) and a one-tap claim over it would be false. Caveat: the copy block's pills are Description/Price, which are on the screen above this scroll offset rather than in frame.

The 'Gotowy do publikacji?' sheet: the three photos, final title, OLX category path, price and a green 'Tak, publikuj' next to 'Poczekaj, chce edytowac'. 'Publish with confidence' / 'Final check before OLX' is literally this sheet. Still pre-publish, so no 'live' wording.

The ONLY capture in the whole pipeline that shows a published listing, so the 'live' copy block finally has an honest home: green tick, 'Opublikovano!', the listing card with its price, the copyable olx.ua link, and a Status tile reading 'Ochikuye - pereverte ogoloshennya na OLX'. 'Your listing is live' / 'Status and link always at hand' is a readout of that screen. Restricted to ua with onlyLocales because no other locale has this capture — the other four stop at the pre-publish sheet.
